wrap_event | low | Content extraction for ToolRequested uses json.dumps on arguments with default=str, which may produce unexpected output for non-serializable values. | Confirm that arguments is always serializable or handle edge cases.

handoff.purpose: Define wrap_event function that converts typed events to TransportRecord with content serialization logic.

symbols.name: wrap_event
symbols.note: Converts a typed event to a TransportRecord, extracting content based on event type.

claims.text: Wrap one typed event without discarding its provider-neutral payload.
claims.why: The function takes an event and returns a TransportRecord that includes the payload via asdict(event). The payload is preserved.

claims.text: direction must be input, output, or system
claims.why: The code explicitly checks for these three values and raises ValueError otherwise.

claims.text: event_type is derived from the class name converted to snake_case
claims.why: The regex pattern _CAMEL_BOUNDARY is defined outside this chunk, so its correctness cannot be verified from this chunk alone.

claims.text: Content is extracted based on event type: TextDelta, AgentMessage, ToolRequested, ToolCompleted, FileRead, CommandOutput, SessionEnded
claims.why: The code handles each of these types (TextDelta, AgentMessage, ToolRequested, ToolCompleted, FileRead, CommandOutput, SessionEnded) with specific content extraction.

claims.text: For TextDelta, content is event.text; for AgentMessage, content is event.content
claims.where: content = event.text if isinstance(event, TextDelta) else event.content
claims.why: The conditional assignment matches the claim.

claims.text: For ToolRequested, content is tool_name and arguments serialized
claims.why: The code constructs the content string as described.

claims.text: For ToolCompleted, content is json.dumps of result
For FileRead, content is path and content
claims.why: The code concatenates path and content with newline.

claims.text: For CommandOutput, content is command and output
claims.why: The code concatenates command and output with newline.

claims.text: For SessionEnded, content is exit_code and stderr
claims.why: The code constructs the string as described, then strips whitespace.

claims.text: Otherwise, content is json.dumps of payload
claims.why: The default case uses json.dumps on the payload.

claims.text: record_id is formatted as session_id:direction:sequence with zero-padded sequence
claims.why: The format string uses :08d for zero-padding to 8 digits.

claims.text: timestamp is current UTC time in ISO format
claims.why: The code uses datetime.now with timezone.utc and isoformat.

claims.text: metadata is a dict from the provided metadata or empty dict
claims.why: The expression dict(metadata or {}) ensures a dict is returned.

observations.what: The function uses asdict(event) which may raise TypeError if event is not a dataclass.
Content extraction for ToolRequested and ToolCompleted uses json.dumps with default=str, which may produce unexpected output for non-serializable objects.
Content extraction for SessionEnded does not handle None stderr; event.stderr could be None.
